inputs.prompt: Use image 1 for EXACT sheet layout, object positions and silhouettes ONLY. Image 2 is the original illustration for art direction. Redraw fresh high-resolution clean 2D storybook watercolor and colored-pencil game assets: soft peach, butter yellow, muted sage and warm gray, delicate continuous dark warm-gray pencil outlines, matte pigment and fine paper grain INSIDE the painted objects. Keep the original cute round proportions and faces. The drawing must be genuinely flat and hand painted, with no volumetric rendering, no bevel, no gloss, no lighting highlight, no embossed rim, no hard drop shadow, no plastic or candy material. Outside every object use perfectly uniform pure WHITE #ffffff, no paper noise or shadow outside silhouettes, no white sticker border. All silhouettes closed, clean and anti-aliased; no torn furry alpha edge. No text, labels, digits, logos or watermarks. Do not add a scene or rearrange cells. Draw ONLY the one little front-facing yellow wooden animal shelter with the orange gabled roof and brown arched door. The house is empty with NO animals anywhere. Repair the lower wall corners so both lower walls are complete and the two little side windows are intact. Thin pencil outlines, light vertical watercolor wood grain, a matte orange roof, warm flat brown door; a simple cozy illustration, not a dimensional game icon. No ground or floor. Same silhouette as the guide.
inputs.negative_prompt: plastic, 3d, glossy, bevel, embossed, shiny, airbrush, fake fur edges, torn edges, thick white sticker border, jagged pixel outline, text, words, watermark, cell borders, extra objects
